name: FLUOXETINE 20 MG 28 CAPSULES
description: Fluoxetine is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressant. It works by increasing serotonin levels in the brain, which helps regulate mood, emotions, and sleep. It is a prescription medication that can only be prescribed by a doctor. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
